info.name: QuickFind API
info.description: QuickFind product search & recommendation API. Run the folders in order (the first folder stores ids used later). Set baseUrl to http://localhost:8080 (default) or http://localhost:3000 to go through the frontend proxy.

exec: pm.test("Has sizes and colors", () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.sizes).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(p.colors).to.be.an("array"); });

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Puma Postman Test Runner {{$timestamp}}",
  "description": "Created from the Postman collection",
  "brandId": {{brandId}},
  "categoryId": {{subcategoryId}},
  "price": 5999.0,
  "discountPercent": 20,
  "rating": 4.2,
  "reviewCount": 3,
  "stockQuantity": 12,
  "colorIds": [
    {{colorId}}
  ],
  "sizes": [
    "UK 8",
    "UK 9"
  ]
}

exec: pm.test("Top hit is a running shoe", () => pm.expect(body.content[0].product.subcategory).to.eql("Running Shoes"));
